title: Adapter Manifest
description: Manifest entry for a generated adapter (Claude command or agent skill). Emitted by tools/capability_sync/ when generating adapter files.

adapter_type.description: Which agent surface this adapter serves.

adapter_path.description: Repository-relative path to the adapter file.

canonical_contract.description: Repository-relative path to the canonical skill Markdown.

generated.description: True if this adapter was generated from the canonical contract; false if hand-written.

generated_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical contract body at generation time. Used for drift detection.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the adapter was last generated.

generator.description: Path to the generator script that produced this adapter.

internal.description: Whether the skill is internal (excluded from Claude command adapters).
